addition.item: Added a dedicated global and language-specific WebSite name for WebSite schema and og:site_name.
Added Joomla core Schema.org graph enhancement so core structured data can remain enabled without competing JT SEO Article/WebPage graphs.
Added a database update marker for version 1.0.67.

change.item: Improved multilingual structured data identity handling by separating Organization/LocalBusiness name from WebSite name.
Improved Joomla core Schema.org compatibility by enriching the native graph in place when it is available.
Improved Organization logo output with absolute URL and contentUrl values.
Kept page-builder and non-article pages as WebPage structured data without synthetic article dates.
Updated package, component, plugin, asset and health-check versions to 1.0.67.

fix.item: Fixed Joomla Article structured data missing datePublished and dateModified when Joomla core schema output is active.
Fixed datePublished fallback to Joomla created date when publish_up is unavailable.
Fixed dateModified fallback to datePublished when a separate modification date is unavailable.
Fixed relative Schema image and logo URLs resolving below multilingual page paths and causing 404 errors.
Fixed WebSite.name and og:site_name using the default-language site identity on other languages.
Prevented JT SEO from publishing a competing Article/WebPage JSON-LD graph when the Joomla core Schema.org graph is detected.

addition.item: Added frontend JSON-LD structured data output for Joomla pages.
Added Organization and LocalBusiness schema support.
Added dedicated homepage schema configuration.
Added WebSite, WebPage, Article and ImageObject structured data support.
Added component-independent WebPage schema support for SP Page Builder and other non-article Joomla pages.
Added multilingual schema fields based on Joomla language tags.
Added language-specific Organization name, alternate name, description, logo, email, telephone and address values.
Added dateModified to Article structured data using the Joomla article modification date.
Added Organization logo support for structured data and Open Graph image fallback.
Added database update marker for version 1.0.66.

change.item: Improved structured data handling from administrator preview mappings to frontend JSON-LD output.
Improved Open Graph site name handling with multilingual Organization values when available.
Improved Article structured data with publication date, modification date, author, image, category and publisher relationships.
Improved structured data compatibility for Joomla page builders and non-article component pages.
Updated Structured Data configuration options and administrator language strings.
Updated package, component and plugin versions to 1.0.66.
Updated README documentation for the 1.0.66 release.

fix.item: Added duplicate structured data detection to reduce conflicting JSON-LD output when a template or another extension already provides schema markup.
Prevented duplicate WebPage and Article schema output when matching structured data already exists on the page.
Improved schema relationship handling to avoid invalid references when existing structured data is detected.
Passed JED Checker validation for the 1.0.66 package.

change.item: Improved custom sitemap URL rule matching on multilingual Joomla websites.
Improved language-prefixed path handling for Included URLs and Excluded URLs rules.
Updated package, component, plugin and asset versions to 1.0.65.3.

fix.item: Fixed wildcard matching for sitemap exclusion rules such as /mycotoxin/*.
Fixed child URLs remaining in multilingual sitemap output when their parent path was excluded with a wildcard rule.
Fixed package manifest version reporting.
Fixed invalid or missing package-level file references reported by JED Checker.
Improved Joomla Extension Directory compatibility.

addition.item: Added XML image sitemap support for articles and categories.
Added article image detection from Joomla Images and Links fields.
Added article content image detection from HTML image elements.
Added image count display in the sitemap browser stylesheet.
Added global sitemap include and exclude URL rules.
Added wildcard support for sitemap URL exclusions, such as /tag/*.

change.item: Improved sitemap image handling with support for multiple images per URL.
Improved sitemap URL filtering logic for custom include and exclude rules.
Improved URL normalization for sitemap filtering operations.
Improved sitemap generation compatibility with Joomla 6 routing.
Updated package, component, plugin and asset versions to 1.0.65.2.

fix.item: Fixed missing article images in XML sitemap output when image integration was enabled.
Fixed sitemap image extraction for images embedded inside article content.
Fixed sitemap filtering edge cases for excluded URL paths and child URLs.
Fixed JED Checker false positive detection caused by URL decoding patterns.
Added database update marker for version 1.0.65.2.

addition.item: Added multilingual sitemap index support with language-specific sitemap files.
Added paginated sitemap output for large multilingual websites.
Added support for sitemap files using language tags and page indexes, such as sitemap.tr-TR.1.xml and sitemap.en-GB.1.xml.
Added a maximum links per sitemap file setting for sitemap pagination.

change.item: Changed sitemap.xml to serve as a master sitemap index when multilingual sitemap output is enabled.
Improved sitemap index output to include language-specific paginated sitemap files.
Improved browser display consistency for SEF and non-SEF sitemap XML URLs.
Updated package, component, plugin and asset versions to 1.0.64.

fix.item: Fixed sitemap exclusion for Joomla menu items with robots settings containing noindex.
Fixed sitemap generation so noindex menu paths and their child URLs are excluded from sitemap output.
Fixed tag menu sitemap leakage when a tag menu path such as /tag is marked as noindex.
Fixed missing XML stylesheet display for SEF sitemap.xml output.
Improved cleanup of old generated sitemap files during installation and updates.
Added database update marker for version 1.0.64.

addition.item: Added multilingual sitemap support for Joomla websites using multiple content languages.
Added sitemap index output for multilingual websites via sitemap.xml.
Added dedicated sitemap output for each published content language.
Added a new multilingual sitemap configuration option.

change.item: Improved sitemap generation to respect Joomla content language values.
Improved article URL generation by using language-aware Joomla routing.
Added multilingual sitemap support based on community feedback from GitHub user @niaziblog.
Updated package, component and plugin versions to 1.0.63.

fix.item: Improved sitemap compatibility for multilingual Joomla websites.

Fixed Bulk Meta Manager button wrapping on narrow layouts.
